description: This file defines various convolutional neural network modules, including Conv1d, Conv2d, Conv3d and their transposed variants. It includes base classes, implementation details, initializations, and lazy module variants for deferred in_channels inference.

classes.name: _ConvNd
classes.description: A base class for N-dimensional convolution modules encapsulating common logic and constants.

classes.name: Conv1d
classes.description: Implements 1D convolutional layer with detailed documentation about operation, shape, init, and args.

classes.name: Conv2d
classes.description: Implements 2D convolutional layer with detailed documentation about operation, shape, init, and args.

classes.name: Conv3d
classes.description: Implements 3D convolutional layer with detailed documentation about operation, shape, init, and args.

classes.name: _ConvTransposeNd
classes.description: Base class for N-dimensional transposed convolution layers, handling padding, output shape, and related logic.

classes.name: ConvTranspose1d
classes.description: Implements 1D transposed convolution (deconvolution) with relevant documentation and calculation details.

classes.name: ConvTranspose2d
classes.description: Implements 2D transposed convolution with detailed documentation and shape formulas.

classes.name: ConvTranspose3d
classes.description: Implements 3D transposed convolution with shape, parameters, and usage info.

classes.name: _ConvTransposeMixin
classes.description: Deprecated internal alias for _ConvTransposeNd, maintained for backward compatibility.

classes.name: _LazyConvXdMixin
classes.description: Mixin class for lazy initialization of convolution modules, supporting deferred in_channels setup.

classes.name: LazyConv1d
classes.description: Lazy variant of Conv1d which infers in_channels at runtime from input shape.

classes.name: LazyConv2d
classes.description: Lazy variant of Conv2d which infers in_channels dynamically.

classes.name: LazyConv3d
classes.description: Lazy variant of Conv3d which infers in_channels dynamically.

classes.name: LazyConvTranspose1d
classes.description: Lazy variant of ConvTranspose1d with in_channels inference.

classes.name: LazyConvTranspose2d
classes.description: Lazy variant of ConvTranspose2d with in_channels inference.

classes.name: LazyConvTranspose3d
classes.description: Lazy variant of ConvTranspose3d with in_channels inference.

methods.name: Tensor _conv_forward( self, input: Tensor, weight: Tensor, bias: Tensor | None )
methods.description: Private method in convolution classes performing the actual convolution operation with padding handling.

methods.name: Tensor forward(self, input: Tensor)
methods.description: Method to compute the output tensor during the forward pass, invoking low-level F.conv* functions.

methods.name: None reset_parameters(self)
methods.description: Initializes weights and biases, applying Kaiming uniform distribution and uniform bias initialization.

methods.name: extra_repr(self)
methods.description: Provides a string representation of important layer parameters for debugging.

methods.name: list[int] _output_padding( self, input: Tensor, output_size: list[int] | None, stride: list[int], padding: list[int], kernel_size: list[int], num_spatial_dims: int, dilation: list[int] | None = None, )
methods.description: Calculates the necessary output padding for transpose convolution layers to match desired output size.

methods.name: int _get_in_channels(self, input: Tensor)
methods.description: Extracts in_channels from input tensor shape for lazy modules.

methods.name: int _get_num_spatial_dims(self)
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to specify number of spatial dimensions (1, 2, 3).
